events.title: 1.92.3 — CALL TO ARMS: report bugs, offer suggestions, build the game YOU want
events.summary: CALL TO ARMS — help build the game YOU want Synapse Grid is a solo-dev game, and in the last month it has been shaped more by players pressing one button than by anything on my roadmap. This post is the next build, a thank-you, a look back at what you fixed — and an ask: keep them coming. Press SPACE in any match — playing, paused, or on the results screen — to open the bug reporter. Fly the frozen scene, click the exact spot you mean, write a line if you want, and SAVE. events.title: Early Access launches October 28, 2026
events.summary: The countdown is on: Synapse Grid enters Early Access on October 28, 2026. No hype — just the facts: Price $7.99 — $4.79 for launch week No microtransactions $7.99 buys the whole game — $4.79 for launch week. There are no microtransactions, no DLC paywalls, no pay-to-win, no paid cosmetics. Every cosmetic is earned by playing. That will never change. events.title: Demo Patch — Online Multiplayer Clarified as Unproven Beta
events.summary: The free demo is live — beta, honest, and upfront about what it is. WHAT'S IN THE DEMO: - 90-mission campaign (subset) - 2–4 player local split-screen - Built-in map editor - Arena combat with light trails WHAT'S NOT READY: Online multiplayer. The netcode is in the build, but it has NOT been proven across real connections. Do not download the demo expecting working online play. Treat it as unfinished beta.
